title: Single-Cell RNA-Seq and Machine Learning Reveal Key Feature Genes of Astrocyte in Perioperative Neurocognitive Disorders.
authors: Zhao, Le; Chen, Zhumei; Ma, Xuelian; Chi, Xinjin
one_liner_zh: 该文用单细胞RNA-seq和机器学习识别围术期神经认知障碍中星形胶质细胞特征基因，虽含转录因子活性分析，但核心是细胞类型与基因表达，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Perioperative neurocognitive disorder (PND) is common in older patients after anesthesia and surgery, significantly increasing morbidity and mortality. However, the role of astrocytes in its pathogenesis remains limitedly understood. Here, we analyzed 9976 and 9484 single-cell transcriptomes from hippocampal cells of aged mice undergoing PND surgery or sham operation, focusing on astrocytes. We identified 13 distinct clusters corresponding to nine cell types, including astrocytes, microglia, neurons, oligodendrocytes, and other relevant cell populations. Specifically, five astrocyte subclusters were identified, with cluster 0 being the most abundant. Its proportion decreased by 5.51% in the PND surgery condition, showing the largest difference between the groups. Functional enrichment analysis revealed that astrocytes are involved in crucial neurodevelopmental processes and pathways associated with nervous system development and synaptic regulation. Pseudotime analysis placed cluster 0 at the early stage of differentiation, suggesting it as a key responsive population. Gene co-expression network further identified modules with peak activity in cluster 0. By intersecting cluster 0 markers with differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and applying machine learning methods, including LASSO, XGBoost, and Random Forest, we pinpointed four feature genes Dbp, PISD, Id4, and Tsc22d3 with differential expression patterns between surgery and control conditions. Transcription factor activity analysis highlighted distinct regulatory networks in astrocytes, providing insights into their functional differences in response to PND surgery. These findings offer a detailed aged hippocampal landscape of astrocyte dynamics and intercellular communication, contributing to our understanding of neuroinflammation and cognitive dysfunction following surgical stress.
abstract_zh: 围手术期神经认知障碍（PND）在老年患者麻醉和手术后常见，显著增加发病率和死亡率。然而，星形胶质细胞在其发病机制中的作用仍了解有限。在此，我们分析了接受PND手术或假手术的老年小鼠海马细胞的9976和9484个单细胞转录组，重点关注星形胶质细胞。我们识别出13个不同的簇，对应9种细胞类型，包括星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞、神经元、少突胶质细胞及其他相关细胞群体。具体而言，鉴定出5个星形胶质细胞亚簇，其中簇0最为丰富。在PND手术条件下，其比例下降了5.51%，显示出组间最大差异。功能富集分析揭示，星形胶质细胞参与关键的神经发育过程以及与神经系统发育和突触调节相关的通路。伪时间分析将簇0置于分化早期阶段，提示其为一个关键响应群体。基因共表达网络进一步识别出在簇0中活性达到峰值的模块。通过将簇0标记基因与差异表达基因（DEGs）相交集，并应用机器学习方法（包括LASSO、XGBoost和随机森林），我们确定了四个特征基因Dbp、PISD、Id4和Tsc22d3，在手术与对照条件之间表现出差异表达模式。转录因子活性分析突出了星形胶质细胞中不同的调控网络，为其响应PND手术的功能差异提供了见解。这些发现提供了老年海马星形胶质细胞动态和细胞间通讯的详细图谱，有助于我们理解手术应激后的神经炎症和认知功能障碍。
